summary: John's 7th-great-grandmother per the tree; wife of Johann Casper Doll.
bio:
Shown in the tree as 'Anna M. Dietz' 1724-1790 with a gravestone image; recorded as 'Margaret' in the 1757 Tohickon Reformed baptism of daughter Anna Catharine. WikiTree (Dietz-563) gives her birthplace as Zweibrücken without a source (speculative); several Dietz families from Eschweiler and Rieschweiler in Zweibrücken settled in Plainfield Twp.

FamilySearch makes her a daughter of Joh. Adam Dietz Sr. (1696-1769) and Anna Catharine Abel (1704-1753), born at Rieschweiler, Zweibrücken, on 15 Feb 1724, and has both parents dying in the Wind Gap and Plainfield area of Northampton Co. ([R4-S1]). That would put her parents in the same community as the Dolls, which is plausible. The birth record is not attached to her profile, though, and the same FamilySearch family has two daughters born in 1724 (Anna Elisabetha and Anna Margaretha) and a second Anna Margaretha in 1733. Treat the parentage as a candidate only. Her death date of 23 Apr 1790 comes from a Pennsylvania cemetery-record entry for 'Margareth Dietz Doll' (its image downloaded empty) and agrees with WikiTree ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]). WikiTree's birthplace 'Zweibrücken' and its stray '29 Oct 1777 Edenkoben' line have no supporting source ([R4-S2]).
